title: Insta-mineable Deepslate
description: This mod allows deepslate to be instamined with efficiency V and haste II!
body:
This mod allows deepslate to be instamined with efficiency V and hast II!

 

Everyone must have thought at least once that it was annoying that you can't instamine deepslate even with the best tools.

 

But with this mod installed, deepslate will never bother you again! Get a netherite pickaxe, enchant it with efficiency V, build a beacon and you're off to mine deepslate like you never mined before!

 

Note: This mod also allows you to instamine other deepslate-like blocks.
